title: Care for your parent
tagline: The right care for your mother or father, the costs shared fairly, and their money kept safe.
trigger: Regular payments to a care home or a home-care service, or you told Kate a parent needs care.

steps.title: What the care costs, and who pays
steps.description: The care-home or home-care bills next to your parent's pension, and the shortfall per month.
steps.why: Based on the care payments on your own account. Nothing is shared.

win.customer: One clear number instead of a pile of bills

steps.result: Care costs overview ready, from the care payments on your account.

steps.title: Find the right care
steps.description: Care homes and home-care services near your parent, with waiting lists and prices compared.
steps.why: CareFinder only receives the region and the kind of care needed, never your parent's or your finances.

win.customer: Care found without calling twenty places

steps.result: CareFinder sent three options near your parent, with prices and waiting times.

steps.title: Share the costs with your brothers and sisters
steps.description: A shared pot for the care bills, with everyone's part visible, so one person doesn't pay for all.
steps.why: They only see the pot, not your accounts.
steps.result: Shared care pot created; your siblings are invited to contribute.

steps.title: Pay your parent's bills, with their permission
steps.description: A power of attorney on your parent's account, signed digitally by your parent, so you can handle the bills.
steps.why: Your parent signs and can withdraw it at any time.

win.customer: Bills paid on time without sharing PIN codes

steps.result: Power of attorney ready for your parent's digital signature.

steps.title: Medical records in one place
steps.description: With your parent's consent, their medical records and medication list in Helena, for you and their carers.
steps.why: Helena only receives your name, e-mail and household. Your parent decides who sees their records.

win.customer: No more chasing letters between doctors

steps.result: Helena account ready; your parent's consent request is sent.

steps.title: Cover for you as a carer, and for your parent
steps.description: Accident insurance for family members who help at home, hospital cover, and online fraud insurance for your parent's account.
steps.why: Older people are the first target of phone and phishing scams.
steps.result: Cover proposed: carer's accident insurance and online fraud insurance for your parent's account.
